name: Computers On The Run Internet
summary: Kilmore VIC region dialup ISP + web hosting; gone by ~2005, ontherun.com.au later taken over by the OTR / Peregrine Corporation convenience-store chain.

events.details: Kilmore-region dialup + web hosting; earliest Wayback capture of ontherun.com.au Dec 1998, listed in the Cynosure ISP directory from Aug 2000.

Last 'Computers On The Run' homepage capture Mar 2000; still listed in the Cynosure ISP directory to Jun 2005; ontherun.com.au taken over by On The Run (Peregrine Corporation) convenience stores by Aug 2006. The earlier 'defunct ~Dec 2014' reflected the unrelated convenience-store site. Last retail ISP homepage archived 2 Mar 2000, followed by six years of total capture silence and re-use by the OTR convenience chain from Jan 2006 — best death estimate is c. 2000-01, not 2005.

refs.label: Last archived retail ISP homepage, 2 Mar 2000
Six-year archive silence implies the site itself was gone, not merely uncrawled (regular captures 1998-2000 and 2006+)
By Jan 2006 the domain served the unrelated SA On The Run convenience chain
Cynosure listing persisted to mid-2005 but is non-discriminative: ALL Cynosure ISP entries end mid-2005 (directory horizon), incl. long-dead ISPs
